replies.body: The YAML is the code for the map. It creates spawn points, monument locations, ect. Try asking another map maker to assist you with creating it so you can get some experience :D

replies.author: Flebula
replies.body: How do I make the map so it can be seen by other people and can be accepted and put on to nebula? I know I have to be accepted first, but how do I make it so it is even possible for a map dev/mod to accept or deny?
replies.body_tagged: How do I make the map so it can be seen by other people and can be accepted and put on to nebula? I know I have to be accepted first, but how do I make it so it is even possible for a map dev/mod to accept or deny?

replies.author: IviFetita
replies.body:
Put it on a server and take some screenshots of it.
Read the following topics:
How to Package a Map      
Avicus YAML Resources

replies.author: Flebula
replies.body: So if I made the map in a single player mode, my map could still get accepted?
replies.body_tagged: So if I made the map in a single player mode, my map could still get accepted?

replies.author: IviFetita
replies.body:
Yeah, but.... Did you use MCEdit for do it, or something else? If you made a map without help, it may be simple and small :/
But, If the map is following the rules, is bigger, has his YML, and it's a very interesting gameplay, I think that may be accepted... Good luck!
(I recommend that for you, have peace and know all the rules and what you should do)
"put it on a server and build the map with friends, and it will be better and more easy"
-make it better-
